question: Who, with the help of Kautilya, overthrew Dhanananda the last Nanda ruler?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** was the one who, with the help of **Kautilya,** overthrew** Dhanananda**, the last **Nanda ruler.**
 
• Kautilya was a** renowned economist, philosopher, and royal advisor** to Chandragupta Maurya.
 
 
• He is also known as **Chanakya.**
 
 
 
• ** Pushyamitra Shunga,** was a general who assassinated the **last Mauryan ruler, Brihadratha**, and established the **Shunga dynasty.**
 
• **Ashoka** was the grandson of Chandragupta Maurya and ruled over the Mauryan empire after his father **Bindusara.**
 
• **Akbar **was a **Mughal emperor** who ruled India from **1556 to 1605. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** was the **founder of the Mauryan Empire**, which was one of the largest empires of ancient India. 
 
• **Kautilya **was the author of the famous book** Arthashastra,** which is considered one of the greatest works on economics and political science in ancient India.
 
• He is known for his **persecution of Buddhists** and for being the **first Brahmin king **to rule over North India after the Mauryan period. 
 
• **Ashoka** is known for his conversion to **Buddhism** after the bloody Kalinga War and for his efforts to spread the teachings of Buddha throughout his empire.
 
 
• He is also known for his** rock edicts and pillar inscriptions**, which are some of the earliest examples of Indian epigraphy. 
 
 
 
• **Akbar **was known for his **religious tolerance, administrative reforms, and military conquests**.
 
 
• He is considered one of the **greatest emperors **of the Mughal dynasty.
